title: Winter storm
tldr: Stay indoors and postpone travel during dangerous snow, ice or blowing snow. Keep heat safe, use battery lighting and watch for power loss. If stranded in a vehicle, stay with it unless a safer shelter is clearly accessible.
steps: Use official closures and forecasts before deciding to travel.
Wear dry layers; never heat a home with an oven, grill or indoor generator.
Keep essential medicines, water, food, light and charged batteries accessible.
Call for help with your location. If running the engine briefly for heat, first clear snow from the exhaust and crack a window; monitor for carbon monoxide.
next: Check on people who rely on powered equipment or may lack safe heat. Arrange relocation before indoor temperatures become dangerous.
watch: Do not walk away from a stranded vehicle in poor visibility unless you know a safe nearby destination.
